messages.subject: use renjin behind a proxy
parts:
Dear Support,

 

I try to use renjin behind a proxy. The command library fails (see example below)

 

> library(FactoMineR)

Error: Could not load package FactoMineR; tried org.renjin.bioconductor:FactoMineR, org.renjin.cran:FactoMineR

I suppose it is because I am behind a proxy. I use a Windows 7 computer and  the following java version.

 

java version "1.8.0_121"

Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 1.8.0_121-b13)

Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM (build 25.121-b13, mixed mode)

 

I have declared HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY environment variables as follow

 

http://mathiae:xxx...@147.67.138.13:8012

 

Many thanks for the support.

messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: use renjin behind a proxy
parts:
Dear Mathieu,

you are receiving this error because there is no artifact for the FactoMinR package in our repository. It is not available for Renjin at this time, see http://packages.renjin.org/package/org.renjin.cran/FactoMineR. The problem is that it depends on the knitr package* which we cannot (yet) build for Renjin.

Regards,

Maarten-Jan

*) for reasons which I do not understand as it imports the "knit" function, but doesn't seem to do anything with it in the code. I will contact the author of the package to inquire about this.

messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: use renjin behind a proxy
parts:
Dear Mathieu,

good news: the author of the FactoMineR package has agreed to remove knitr from the Imports of the package and put it in Suggests. Once this gets pushed to CRAN, we will need to rebuild the package for Renjin so poke us again if we forget to do this.

Regards,

Maarten-Jan
